== Summary ==
Crop of [[:File:2023 World Championship group photo.jpg]]: person no. 20 in the [[2023 World Championship]] group photograph (black T-shirt, flexing both arms). This person is the [[Help Complete the Archive|featured mystery]]; if you know the name, post on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 General board] of the [https://swccg.com/forum/ SWCCG Forum], or write on the Talk page of this File or on [[Talk:Help Complete the Archive]].
